en: WAHAHAH! So you stopped my waterfall! You've got nerve, I'll give you that!
I'm Chuck, and my fists do my talking! My Pokémon and I train harder than anyone. Show me what you've got!
Whoa! What power! I've got no excuse. You beat me fair and square. Take the Storm Badge!
{player} received the Storm Badge from Chuck!
With the Storm Badge, Pokémon up to level seventy will obey you. And you can use Fly outside of battle!
Here, this is my favourite! Put everything you have into one punch!
TM01 is Focus Punch. Get hit while you're winding up and you'll lose your nerve, so be careful with it!
Back to the waterfall for me! I can't let a loss like that go unanswered. HWAAAH!
Chuck is training under the waterfall, roaring at the top of his voice. He can't hear a thing over the water.
A big winch works the waterfall's sluice. Turn it?
{player} turned the winch with all their strength!
The waterfall slowed to a trickle!
The winch is turned. Only a trickle of water falls.
